content: {"episode_id":"ep-05002","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for episode ep-05002, which SilverBridge based on precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9 and I48.91. As the note states, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment given the need to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies. We therefore request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 701.94 on the basis of medical necessity as documented in the ordering note."}
